name: BPM tapper
summary: Tap along to find a song's tempo
description: Tap, click or press a key along to a song to find its tempo: average and recent BPM, consistency, half/double time, a per-tap chart and a beat counter.

name: CSV ⇄ JSON converter
description: Convert CSV to JSON and JSON to CSV, with delimiter detection, quoted fields and line breaks, number and boolean detection, nested objects as dotted columns, and a sortable, filterable table preview.

name: Gzip helper
description: Compress text or files to gzip, zlib or raw deflate, and decompress them from a file, Base64 or hex, with header details (file name, date, OS), checksum checks and multi-member support.

name: JSON diff
description: Compare two JSON documents (or any text) structurally: changes by path, shared properties, JSON Patch, combinable field filters and saved comparisons.

name: JSON formatter
description: Format, minify and validate JSON with exact error locations, repair common mistakes (comments, trailing commas, single quotes), browse it as a collapsible tree and query it by path.

name: Timestamp converter
summary: Convert Unix times, ISO 8601 and time zones
description: Convert between Unix seconds, milliseconds, microseconds and nanoseconds, ISO 8601, RFC 2822 and dates in any time zone, in either direction, with a live clock and relative times such as “3 hours ago” or “in 2 days”.
